3. The petitioners are apprehending arrest in connection with Talsari Marine P.S. Case No. 97 of 2023 corresponding to C.T. Case No. 687 of 2023 pending in the court of the learned Grama Nyayalaya-cum-JMFC, Bhograi, Balasore for the alleged commission of offence under Sections 341/294/323/363/420/326/307/34 of IPC.

entities.text: Talsari Marine P.S. Case No. 97 of 2023
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: 4. It is alleged that the daughter of the informant was sent by her with one Prakash Barik to Lord Maa Naikani at Digha, West Bengal on condition of returning within two hours but she did not return for which when she along with her husband and sons proceeded to the house of said Prakash Barik and requested him to return their daughter, Prakash Barik and other petitioners assaulted them by means of bamboo stick and iron rod causing injury.
5. Considering the nature of accusations and the materials on record, I am not inclined to grant anticipatory bail to the petitioners.

The ABLAPL is however, disposed of granting liberty to the petitioners to surrender before the court below within two weeks from the date of receipt of certified copy of this order and to move for bail.
In such event, they shall be released on bail on such terms and conditions as the court below may deem fit and proper to impose.

It is clarified that the order Nilima @ Lilima Barik vs State Of Odisha .... Opposite Party on 17 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/199298225/
1 shall be operative only if the injury is found to be simple in nature.
